{total} entities of «{titulo}» will move to this integration with their history and statistics: {entidades}.

They will be renamed to **sensor.pvpc_bs_*** (for example, sensor.esios_pvpc → sensor.pvpc_bs_precio). The Energy dashboard is updated automatically; your scripts, automations and dashboards must be changed by hand: the full list will be shown in Repairs when finished.

The PVPC Next entry will be disabled; afterwards you can delete it and uninstall PVPC Next and its card from HACS.

**Make a Home Assistant backup first.**

falta_fecha_factura.title: Last bill date missing for «{suministro}»
falta_fecha_factura.description: The end date of the last bill is needed to know which period is being billed (the bill shows «from X to Y»: it is Y). Add it in Settings → Devices & services → PVPC + Bono Social → gear icon ⚙ of «{suministro}» (Reconfigure).

usar_estadistica_coste.title: Use the PVPC + Bono Social cost in the Energy dashboard («{suministro}»)

confirmar.title: Change the Energy dashboard cost
confirmar.description:
The Energy dashboard computes the grid cost with «{actual}». The statistic {nueva} holds your COR bill cost hour by hour (with bono social, taxes and fixed terms) and is corrected backwards when the estimate changes. Do you want to use it as the cost in the Energy dashboard? You can change it back at any time from the dashboard itself.

{nueva} will be set as the grid consumption «cost» in the Energy dashboard.

shelly_no_coincide.title: The Shelly does not match HA in «{suministro}»
shelly_no_coincide.description: Over the last 7 days the Shelly ({ip}) and HA consumption differ by {diferencia} %. Nothing is corrected until they match again. Check that the IP and channel belong to the meter used by the supply.

factura_no_cuadra.title: The «{suministro}» bill from {inicio} to {fin} does not match the CNMC
factura_no_cuadra.description: Bill: €{factura}. The official CNMC simulator, with the same meter kWh, your contracted power and social bonus, computes €{cnmc} (€{diferencia} difference). Check the bill with your retailer. If you already did, ignore this notice: it will not appear again for this bill.

facturacion_no_soportada.title: The bill is not calculated in {territorio}
facturacion_no_soportada.description:
The bill (current period, forecast, today's cost, tariff comparison and CNMC check) is only built for the Peninsula and the Balearic Islands: it uses Madrid time, its periods and VAT. In {territorio} it would be wrong, so supplies are not loaded and their entities are unavailable. PVPC prices keep working.

If you do not need the supplies, delete them in Settings → Devices & services → PVPC + Bono Social. If you are actually in the Peninsula or the Balearic Islands, check the selected tariff and Home Assistant's time zone.

reconfigure.title: Supply
reconfigure.description: What do you want to do?

data_description.categoria: Sets the yearly discounted kWh limit (RD 897/2017). Required with bono social.
data_description.tipo_fuente: The bill cannot be computed without an hourly consumption source.

fuente.title: Consumption source
fuente.description: An energy sensor (kWh, cumulative) or an external statistic that imports the hourly curve (for example, from Datadis).

factura.title: Bill
factura.description: The end date of the last bill sets the current billing period. If you don't know it, leave it empty: it can be adjusted when reconciling the first bill.

data.dias_hasta_emision: Days between the end of the period and the issue date
data.segunda_opinion_cnmc: Check each bill with the CNMC

data_description.arrastre_inicial_kwh: The discounted kWh left over in the last 12 months that you have not used yet. If you do not know, leave 0: it is corrected when bills are reconciled.
data_description.codigo_postal: Optional. Only used to compare tariffs: the postal code, the contracted power and the yearly kWh per period are sent to the CNMC, nothing else.
data_description.comparar_mensual: On the 2nd of every month, compares your last 12 months with the CNMC offers and leaves a notification. Needs the postal code.
data_description.segunda_opinion_cnmc: When you enter an actual bill, the integration asks the official CNMC simulator for the same bill (with the bill's meter kWh) and warns you if it does not match. Hourly consumption, power, bonus type and postcode are sent (no CUPS). Needs the postcode.
data_description.comparador_destino: Optional. A notify entity (a Telegram chat, your phone…). Besides the Home Assistant notification, the comparison (button or monthly) is sent there.
data_description.comparador_umbral_eur: Only with “Only if an offer saves money”: the best offer must save more than this per year.
data_description.fin_ultima_factura: End of the last bill: it is the start of the current period. When reconfiguring, the one in force is suggested; if you change it, the current period starts on that day (also backwards) and the later estimated periods are recalculated.

comprobacion.title: Shelly EM check (optional)
comprobacion.description: If the meter is a 1st-generation Shelly EM, the integration can download its internal memory every night (10-minute data for almost a year) and correct the hours that are missing or wrong in HA statistics. Leave the IP empty to skip it.

factura_real.title: Actual bill
factura_real.description: Upload the bill PDF to read its data automatically, or a **ZIP with several bills** to enter them all at once (only bills from Comercializadora Regulada, Gas & Power, Naturgy). You can also leave it empty and type the data in the next step.

factura_datos.title: Actual bill details
factura_datos.description: Check the data exactly as printed on the bill. They set the real billing period, recalibrate the meter, correct the social bonus carry-over and rewrite the period cost in the Energy dashboard. A bill overlapping one already entered (for example, a corrective bill) replaces it.

data_description.inicio: The day shown as the start of the period ("from … to …").
data_description.kwh_bonificados: The kWh with social bonus discount shown on the bill. Leave it empty if you have no social bonus.

cambio_contrato.title: Contract change
cambio_contrato.description: You changed the contracted power, the social bonus or the household size. Enter the day the new contract starts: the earlier days of the period are calculated with the old one. If you are only fixing a wrong value, leave the date empty and it will apply to everything.

data_description.vigente_desde: The first day with the new contract (as stated by the supplier's letter or the bill).

factura_lote.title: Bills in the ZIP

factura_hecha.title: Bill entered
factura_hecha.description: Bill from {inicio} to {fin} entered. Add another one?

error.categoria_requerida: With bono social the household must be set.
error.fuente_en_uso: That source is already used by another supply.
error.estadistica_no_externa: Choose an external statistic (domain:object). For a sensor, go back and choose «Energy sensor».
error.fuente_no_encontrada: That entity does not exist or has no state yet.
error.fuente_no_energia: The sensor must be an energy sensor (kWh, Wh or MWh) with state_class total or total_increasing.
error.pdf_no_reconocido: The PDF is not recognised. Only bills from Comercializadora Regulada, Gas & Power (Naturgy) can be read; for others, leave the file empty and enter the data by hand.
error.pdf_no_subido: The uploaded file could not be read. Upload it again.
error.es_abono: This is a credit note (corrective bill with a negative amount). Upload the bill that replaces it.
error.periodo_no_valido: The billing period must be between 1 and 62 days long.
error.fecha_futura: It cannot be a future date: make the change on the day it starts.
error.codigo_postal_invalido: The postal code must have 5 digits
error.zip_sin_facturas: The ZIP has no readable bill (only PDFs from Comercializadora Regulada, Gas & Power are read).
error.antes_de_factura_real: There is already a real bill ending after that date: the current period cannot start before that bill ends.

abort.periodo_cambiado: Supply updated. The current billing period now starts on {inicio}; it is recalculated from that day.
abort.no_cargada: The integration is not loaded. Enable it and try again.
abort.no_soportado_canarias: The bill is only calculated for the Peninsula and the Balearic Islands. In the Canary Islands (Home Assistant time zone Atlantic/Canary) Canary time and IGIC apply, which the integration does not handle. PVPC prices do work.
abort.no_soportado_ceuta_melilla: The bill is only calculated for the Peninsula and the Balearic Islands. Ceuta and Melilla have other periods and IPSI, which the integration does not handle. PVPC prices do work.

user.title: Price summary notification
user.description: A morning message with today's prices and an evening one with tomorrow's prices compared with today, as an emoji bar chart.

data.resto_hoy: At night, include the remaining hours of today

data_description.destino: Any notify entity. If it is a Telegram chat, the message is formatted (aligned columns) and you do not need to type the chat ID.
data_description.manana_hora: ESIOS publishes tomorrow's prices around 20:20. If they are not out yet, it retries every 10 minutes until 23:00.
data_description.color_valle: On weekends and holidays the whole day is off-peak: with "working days", its hours are coloured against the 5 previous working days.
data_description.mostrar_periodo: After the hour, P peak, S standard or O off-peak. On weekends and holidays the whole day is off-peak and it is not shown.
data_description.formato_tabla: How each hour is drawn. «Two columns» has no room for the arrows against today.
data_description.resto_hoy: Before tomorrow's 24 hours, the hours left today for comparison. The arrows against today are shown either way.

user.title: Datadis account
user.description: Optional: the official hourly consumption of your meter, from datadis.es. It is downloaded once a day and stored as an energy statistic that you can choose as a supply's consumption source or use as a reference. If Datadis returns no data, everything keeps working with your meter.

suministro.title: Supply
suministro.description: Your account has several supplies: choose one (you can add another Datadis account for each).

reconfigure.title: Datadis
reconfigure.description: What do you want to do?

importar_csv.title: Import Datadis CSV
importar_csv.description: Upload the consumption CSV downloaded from datadis.es (Consumo_….csv). It is checked like the API data: days with repeated hours or identical to another day are discarded.

error.no_responde: Datadis is not responding. Try again later.
error.sin_suministros: Datadis returns no supply for this account.
error.csv_no_valido: Not a Datadis consumption CSV (date, hour and consumption columns missing).
error.csv_vacio: The CSV has no consumption data.

abort.reconfigure_successful: Account updated: Datadis will be queried now.
abort.no_cargada: The integration is not loaded. Enable it and try again.

conciliar_factura.name: Reconcile bill
conciliar_factura.description: Enter the real bill of a period. It sets the real cut-off date, recalibrates the meter, corrects the bono social balance and rewrites the period cost statistic with the real total.

inicio.name: Period start
inicio.description: The «from X» date of the bill (that day is not billed).

fin.name: Period end
fin.description: The «to Y» date of the bill.

emision.name: Issue date
emision.description: The bill date (if omitted, end + days until issue).

kwh_bonificados.name: Discounted kWh
kwh_bonificados.description: Sum of discounted kWh on the bill (optional, improves the bono calculation).

enviar_resumen.name: Send price summary
enviar_resumen.description: Sends today's or tomorrow's price summary to the configured destinations or to a given one. With "Only return the text" nothing is sent and the message is returned.

manana.name: Tomorrow
manana.description: Tomorrow's summary compared with today (otherwise, today's).

destino.name: Destination
destino.description: Notify entity. If not given, it is sent to all configured summaries.

dry_run.name: Only return the text
dry_run.description: Sends nothing: returns the text in the service response.

comparar_tarifas.name: Compare tariffs
comparar_tarifas.description: Compares what was paid in the last 12 months with the offers of the CNMC comparator for the supply's postal code and stores the result in the "Best tariff alternative" sensor.

destino.name: Destination
destino.description: Notify entity (for example, a Telegram chat) to also send the result to.

notificacion.name: Persistent notification
notificacion.description: Leaves the result (or the error) in a persistent notification.
